ActorTalk: Thanks to you, Commandant. I'll adjust to this new frame as fast as I can.
Frostheart Emperor was a title used by Sophiasburgh's rulers... but I've never heard of anyone named Zack.
He's the one who ambushed my Constructs in the Arctic. I never imagined he'd sneak into our escort team.
This frame was based on my grandfather's blueprints. The Arctic Route Union still hasn't fully cracked the tech. What does he want with that data...?
No, now's not the time for that. Commandant, just like that Frostheart Emperor said, those things crawling out of the glacier are attacking people in the Arctic.
What I need to do now is return to New Sophiasburgh. Commandant... can Babylonia help me get back to Earth?
I'm fully aware of the situation.
You and Rosetta should return here. President Hassen also asked me to pass along a message.
He seems to be gathering data on your frame.
